domain:ui#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRFuJz9QBZqPVHYVhJ

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：在手机 App 里点开推送时，通知里的应用内链接（如 `/opportunity/123`）现在会像收件箱一样，放进对应的应用里打开记录，不再落到首页。以这种链接作为首个网址直接打开时也一样。
- **为什么改**：推送契约（#29218）要求点开推送「按收件箱的方式解析，不能原样跳转」。之前 Console 原样跳转，匹配不到路由就回首页，推送一上线（#29041）就打不开记录。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 Console 前端路由，无服务端、无数据改动。有一个可见变化：浏览器里打开一个不存在的、首段也不是 Console 页面的网址（如 `/foo/bar`），现在会进入默认应用并显示该应用的「页面未找到」，不再回首页。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/apps/console/src/components/UnmatchedRoute.tsx`（兜底路由）、`ui/apps/console/src/App.tsx` 的 `NativeShellRouting`、`ui/apps/console/src/nativeShellRoute.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/nativeShellRoute-29750.test.ts`，预期全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无。席位验收后进合并队列。

**席位意见：** 解析用的是收件箱同一个函数，没有另写一份。冷启动时 App 还没打开任何应用，监听器拿不到应用列表，所以交给兜底路由等列表到齐再放；这条路也顺带覆盖了手机壳以首个网址送达的三种情况。`/foo/bar` 不再回首页是本席裁定的取舍，已实测落在应用自己的「页面未找到」，没有循环跳转。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:ui#2` · head `b1ed0110` · 2026-11-03T05:59Z

- **形态:** draft PR on `main`, `Fixes #29750` on its own line. 8 files, +451/−10. Tier S: `check-governed-merges --pr 29810` says not governed, under 3000 lines. The surface matches claim 6595211090 / amendment 6595284896, plus the two console-local files the seat approved before code (`nativeShellRoute.ts`, `components/UnmatchedRoute.tsx`) and the one-line `importOriginal` spread in `App.agentChatLink-10640.test.tsx`'s mock (no assertion change). `ui/packages/mobile/**` is untouched. The `@object-ui/app-shell` root gains `resolveNotificationTarget`, `type NotificationTarget` and `CONSOLE_ROOT_SEGMENTS`.
- **前提实测:** on `main` `6f094645`, `useNativeHostRouting` navigates `detail.route` verbatim, so `/opportunity/123` falls to the catch-all and lands on `/`. Live on this branch (app-crm, Vite Console, fake bridge): a tap on `/crm_opportunity/ID` from a fresh Home, from inside the app, and from Home after visiting the app all land on `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_opportunity/record/ID` with the event cancelled. A first URL `/crm_opportunity/ID` lands on the same record, and `/dev/nope` still goes Home. The scope-A condition was measured: `/apps/com.example.crm/foo/bar` shows the app's own "Page not found", with no loop and no page error. Screenshots: `/mnt/project-files/issue-29750/live/`.
- **门禁 check-runs (pinned to head `b1ed011099df377a131cf1d0c820d9427db0b88b`):** 55 runs. At this record, every finished run is success or path-skipped, including `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI` (16/16 plus the aggregate), `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Check Changeset`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `PR-body guards`. `Lint UI` was still running; ready waits for it. Dev local gates: 35 derived, 35 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED; the changeset and sdui-manifest gates were re-run on this head. Console 13 files / 62 tests. Ablations: verbatim navigate reds the in-app hosting case; a catch-all that always goes to `/` reds the six hosting and waiting cases, with the controls green.
- **Code read:** both legs call the inbox's `resolveNotificationTarget`, so the shape is not re-implemented. The listener hosts only under the URL's own `:appName`, which is already the route segment; anywhere else it hands the route on. The catch-all first refuses Console root segments and `apps` (`CONSOLE_ROOT_SEGMENTS`, the table pinned against `App.tsx`'s routes). It then waits under the same `ProtectedRoute` as `/` until the app list's status settles, so a session-cached list being re-read is not taken as an answer. A failed list keeps the old `/`. A signed-out visitor goes through login and returns to the same path.
- **接受的偏差:** the leg-1 host hint is the URL's `:appName` only, and `currentAppName` is re-checked in the catch-all. The live measure showed `currentAppName` is an app NAME and hosting under it re-addressed the page four times. The resolver's `null` / `external` branches are pinned at unit level and are unreachable through the listener by construction (`isInAppRoute` refuses first).
- **范围外去向:** the observation that an `/apps/NAME/...` URL addressed by the app name re-addresses the page several times before settling is recorded here and not filed. This PR no longer produces that form, and the app route recovers on its own. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
- **落地条款:** `Clause-②: no` (`@object-ui/app-shell` and the Console are private, so the new root exports publish nothing), `Metadata-protocol: none`, `patch`. No contract review is owed. Land by `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` once `Lint UI` is green on this head.
